extraFacts.fact: SMC AS-F series speed controller with One-touch fitting (elbow type AS1201F-AS4201F, universal type AS2301F, in-line type AS2002F-AS4002F): part number AS + body size digit + flow-direction digit (0 = meter-out, 1 = meter-in, e.g. AS2201F meter-out, AS2211F meter-in) + 1F; thread prefix none = R (BSPT taper), N = NPT, M5 = M5 x 0.8, U10/32 = 10-32 UNF; thread size 01 = 1/8, 02 = 1/4, 03 = 3/8, 04 = 1/2; tube code 04, 06, 08, 10, 12 = metric OD in mm, 01 = 1/8", 03 = 5/32", 05 = 3/16", 07 = 1/4", 09 = 5/16", 11 = 3/8", 13 = 1/2"; suffix S = thread with sealant. Fluid: air. Operating pressure 0.1 to 1 MPa. Ambient and fluid temperature -5 to 60°C (no freezing). Applicable tubing: nylon, soft nylon and polyurethane. Seals NBR; threaded body brass, electroless nickel plated.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Flow Control Equipment, Speed Controller with One-touch Fitting Series AS-F (How to Order and Specifications)

extraFacts.fact: Meter-out speed control throttles the air leaving the cylinder and gives steady piston speed under varying load; it is the normal choice for double-acting cylinders. Meter-in throttles the supply air and is used for single-acting cylinders. Adjustment: close the needle fully (clockwise), then open it gradually (counter-clockwise) until the cylinder reaches the required speed, and lock it with the lock nut. Insert tube fully into the One-touch fitting; release by pressing the release button. Check that the flow-direction mark matches the circuit.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Flow Control Equipment, Speed Controller technical data and specific product precautions

extraFacts.fact: SMC ASV series speed exhaust controller combines a speed controller and a quick exhaust valve in one body, so the cylinder exhausts directly at its port. SMC ASP series is a speed controller with pilot check valve: when the pilot signal is exhausted the check valve closes and holds the cylinder at an intermediate stop; the pilot port is piped to the opposite cylinder line. SMC ASN2 series is an exhaust throttle valve screwed into the exhaust port of a directional valve to meter the exhaust air.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Flow Control Equipment, Series ASV, ASP and ASN2

extraFacts.fact: SMC AK series check valve: body sizes AK2000 (1/8, 1/4), AK4000 (1/4, 3/8, 1/2), AK6000 (3/4, 1); port thread prefix none = Rc, N = NPT, F = G; port code 06 = 3/4, 10 = 1. SMC AKM series is the modular check valve for the SMC modular air-preparation line; size AKM2000, AKM3000, AKM4000 matches modular units of size 2000, 3000, 4000. Fluid: air. Flow direction is marked on the body by an arrow.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Check Valve Series AK and modular Series AKM

extraFacts.fact: SMC VR1210 (1/8) and VR1220 (1/4) are shuttle valves: the outlet takes air from whichever of the two inlets is pressurised (OR function); VR1210F and VR1220F carry built-in One-touch fittings. Female port prefix none = Rc, N = NPT, F = G.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Shuttle Valve Series VR1210/VR1220

extraFacts.fact: Pipe thread standards: R/Rc (BSPT) taper threads to ISO 7-1; G (BSPP) parallel threads to ISO 228-1; NPT taper threads to ASME B1.20.1. Inch tube outside diameters: 5/32" = 3.97 mm, 1/4" = 6.35 mm, 5/16" = 7.94 mm, 3/8" = 9.53 mm, 1/2" = 12.7 mm (1 in = 25.4 mm).
extraFacts.source: ISO 7-1:1994; ISO 228-1:2000; ASME B1.20.1-2013; inch-to-mm conversion

extraFacts.fact: Unit conversions: 1 bar = 14.5038 psi, so 1 MPa = 10 bar = about 145 psi and 0.1 MPa = 1 bar = about 14.5 psi; +23°F to +140°F = -5 to +60°C; 140°F = 60°C.
HS 2022 heading 84.81: subheading 8481.20 = valves for oleohydraulic or pneumatic transmissions; 8481.30 = check (non-return) valves. The importing country's tariff fixes the final national digits.

faqs.q: What are SMC air cylinder speed controls used for?
faqs.a: SMC air cylinder speed controls are flow controls with push-in tube fittings that set how fast a pneumatic cylinder extends and retracts by throttling its air. This listing holds 215 SMC part numbers: AS1201F to AS4211F elbow controllers, AS2002F to AS4002F in-line types and ASV speed exhaust controllers.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC AS2211F-02-06SD speed controller part number?
faqs.a: AS2211F-02-06SD is an AS2 body, 1 = meter-in, F = push-in fitting, 02 = 1/4 R (BSPT) thread and 06 = 6 mm tube, with S marking thread sealant. An N before the thread code means NPT (AS2201F-N01-07SD), M5 and U10/32 are the small metric and 10-32 UNF threads, and 0 in place of the second 1 gives meter-out.

faqs.q: What thread and tube sizes do SMC air cylinder speed controls cover?
faqs.a: The range runs from M5 and 10-32 UNF ports up to 1/8, 1/4, 3/8 and 1/2 R or NPT, with tube from 3.2 to 12 mm and 1/8" to 1/2". For a single tube size, see listings such as the [SMC 6 mm tube speed controller](/p/smc-speed-control-valve-with-6mm-tube-size) or the [SMC 1/4" tube speed controller](/p/smc-speed-control-valve-with-1-4-tube-size).

faqs.q: Meter-out or meter-in: which SMC air cylinder speed control should I choose?
faqs.a: Choose meter-out (AS2201F, with 0 as the flow digit) for nearly every double-acting cylinder, because throttling the exhaust air gives the steadiest speed under changing load. Meter-in (AS2211F) suits single-acting cylinders. Our [cylinder speed control guide](/blog/cylinder-speed-control-and-quick-exhaust-valves) sets out the circuits.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do SMC air cylinder speed controls have?
faqs.a: Most rows in our size table give 145 psi (1 MPa, about 10 bar) as the maximum, and SMC rates the AS-F controllers from 0.1 MPa (about 14.5 psi) upward. Temperature is +23°F to +140°F (-5 to +60°C) without freezing; check the row for the part you order.

faqs.q: Which thread standards apply to SMC air cylinder speed controls?
faqs.a: SMC air cylinder speed controls come with R (BSPT) taper threads to ISO 7-1, NPT to ASME B1.20.1, or M5 and 10-32 UNF on the smallest bodies, so match the code to the cylinder port. No certificates are held on this listing; ask for a certificate of conformity with the order if needed.

faqs.q: Which tubing and cylinders connect to SMC air cylinder speed controls?
faqs.a: SMC speed controls take nylon, soft nylon or polyurethane tube of the OD in the part number and screw straight into the cylinder port. Matching tube is on our [pneumatic tubing shelf](/c/pneumatic-tubing) and cylinders on the [pneumatic cylinders shelf](/c/pneumatic-cylinders).

faqs.q: How do you set an SMC air cylinder speed control?
faqs.a: Close the needle fully clockwise, then open it slowly counter-clockwise until the cylinder reaches the speed you need, and tighten the lock nut. Fit one controller in each cylinder port, check the flow-direction mark first, and push the tube fully into the fitting.

faqs.q: What is an SMC ASV speed exhaust controller?
faqs.a: An SMC ASV speed exhaust controller combines a speed controller and a quick exhaust valve in one body, so the cylinder dumps air at its port for a fast return stroke. This listing has ASV310F, ASV410F and ASV510F sizes, for example ASV310F-01-06S (1/8 R, 6 mm tube); a separate quick exhaust is the [Parker 0R series quick exhaust valve](/p/parker-0r-series-quick-exhaust-valves).

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC elbow and in-line speed controllers?
faqs.a: An SMC elbow speed controller such as AS2201F screws into the cylinder port, while an in-line type such as AS2002F-06 has push-in fittings at both ends and sits in the tube run. Use in-line where the port is hard to reach or the cylinder has a fitting already.

faqs.q: Where are SMC air cylinder speed controls shipped from and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: We ship SMC air cylinder speed controls from our Dubai warehouse to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Pneumatic flow valves normally fall under HS 8481.20; the country of origin depends on the SMC plant and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.a: Yes. We keep SMC air cylinder speed controls in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the SMC part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is the SMC AK series check valve used for?
faqs.a: The SMC AK series is an in-line check valve that lets compressed air flow one way and blocks it in reverse, for example to hold pressure downstream when the supply drops. It has an aluminium die-cast body and NBR seal, and this listing carries 16 part numbers in AK2000, AK4000 and AK6000 sizes.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC AK check valve part number such as AK4000-N02?
faqs.a: AK4000-N02 is body size AK4000 with a 1/4 NPT port: N means NPT, F means G (BSPP) and no letter means Rc (BSPT). Port codes are 01 = 1/8, 02 = 1/4, 03 = 3/8, 04 = 1/2, 06 = 3/4 and 10 = 1, so AK6000-F10 is a 1 inch G-thread valve.

faqs.q: Which port sizes do SMC AK2000, AK4000 and AK6000 check valves have?
faqs.a: SMC AK2000 check valves have 1/8 and 1/4 ports, AK4000 has 1/4, 3/8 and 1/2, and AK6000 has 3/4 and 1 inch. Pick the body that matches the pipe or fitting thread; the larger body also passes more air.

faqs.q: Which SMC AK series check valve has a 1/2 inch port?
faqs.a: The 1/2 inch SMC AK check valves in this listing are AK4000-04 (Rc thread) and AK4000-F04 (G thread). For NPT lines the nearest listed sizes are AK4000-N02 at 1/4 and AK6000-N06 at 3/4; ask us if you need a 1/2 NPT version.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the SMC AK series check valve have?
faqs.a: The SMC AK series is an air-service check valve, but this listing does not publish a pressure rating for it. Send the part number, such as AK2000-02, and your line pressure, and we confirm the maker figure before quoting.

faqs.q: What materials are SMC AK series check valves made from?
faqs.a: SMC AK series check valves have an aluminium die-cast body and a nitrile rubber (NBR) seal in a straight body shape. They are made for compressed air; for any other fluid check with us before ordering.

faqs.q: Which thread standards do SMC AK check valve ports follow?
faqs.a: SMC AK ports come in three threads: Rc taper to ISO 7-1 (no letter, AK2000-01), G parallel to ISO 228-1 (F, AK2000-F01) and NPT to ASME B1.20.1 (N, AK2000-N01). No certificates are held on this listing; ask for a certificate of conformity with the order.

faqs.q: Which fittings connect to an SMC AK series check valve?
faqs.a: The SMC AK check valve has female ports, so it takes male fittings of the same thread at each end, such as push-in connectors or nipples. Male connectors and adaptors are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How do you install an SMC AK check valve the right way round?
faqs.a: Fit the SMC AK check valve with the arrow on the body pointing in the direction of air flow. Use sealant or tape suited to the thread type, keep it out of the bore, and blow the line clear of chips first.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC AK and AKM check valves?
faqs.a: SMC AK is a stand-alone in-line check valve with threaded ports, while the [SMC AKM series check valve](/p/smc-akm-series-check-valve) is the modular version that fits into SMC’s modular air-preparation line. Choose AK for a pipe run and AKM when building onto modular FRL units.

faqs.q: Where are SMC AK series check valves shipped from and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: We ship SMC AK series check valves from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Check valves normally fall under HS 8481.30 (check, non-return valves); country of origin follows the SMC plant and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you stock SMC AK series check valves in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. SMC AK series check valves are kept in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send part numbers such as AK4000-03 and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a price.

faqs.q: What is the SMC AKM series check valve used for?
faqs.a: The SMC AKM series is a modular check valve that fits into an SMC modular air-preparation line to stop air flowing back upstream. This listing carries 8 part numbers in AKM2000, AKM3000 and AKM4000 sizes.

faqs.q: How do you read an SMC AKM part number such as AKM3000-N02-A?
faqs.a: AKM3000-N02-A is modular body size 3000 with a 1/4 NPT port (N = NPT, 02 = 1/4), plus the option suffix A. No letter before the port code means Rc and F means G, so AKM4000-F03 is a 3/8 G version. Quote suffixes exactly as listed.

faqs.q: Which sizes and threads does the SMC AKM check valve come in?
faqs.a: SMC AKM2000 is listed with 1/8 NPT, 1/4 Rc and 1/4 NPT ports; AKM3000 with 1/4 Rc and 1/4 NPT; and AKM4000 with 3/8 Rc and 3/8 G. That is AKM2000-N01, -02, -N02; AKM3000-02, -N02, -N02-A; AKM4000-03 and -F03.

faqs.q: Which SMC AKM size matches my modular FRL?
faqs.a: Match the AKM number to the modular unit size: AKM2000 for size 2000 units, AKM3000 for 3000 and AKM4000 for 4000. Send the part number of the filter or regulator it will sit beside and we confirm the fit. Modular units are on our [filters, regulators and lubricators shelf](/c/air-preparation-frl).

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the SMC AKM modular check valve have?
faqs.a: This listing does not publish a pressure figure for the SMC AKM check valve, so the rating of the modular line it joins applies. Send the part number, for example AKM2000-N02, with your line pressure and we confirm the maker figure.

faqs.q: Which thread standards do SMC AKM check valve ports use?
faqs.a: SMC AKM ports are Rc taper to ISO 7-1 (AKM2000-02), NPT to ASME B1.20.1 (AKM3000-N02) or G parallel to ISO 228-1 (AKM4000-F03). This listing holds no certificates; ask for a certificate of conformity with the order if your project needs one.

faqs.q: What connects to an SMC AKM modular check valve?
faqs.a: The SMC AKM fits between SMC modular filters, regulators and lubricators of the same size, and its threaded ports take male fittings. Our [FRL guide](/blog/frl-filter-regulator-lubricator-guide) explains where a check valve sits in an air-preparation line.

faqs.q: How do you install an SMC AKM check valve in a modular line?
faqs.a: Install the SMC AKM with the body arrow pointing in the direction of air flow, using SMC modular connecting parts of the same size. Depressurise the line first and check for leaks at each joint before returning it to service.

faqs.q: Where is an SMC AKM check valve used in a compressed-air system?
faqs.a: An SMC AKM check valve is used on the air-preparation line ahead of a machine to stop downstream air bleeding back when the supply is shut off or drops. It keeps pressure in the circuit after the regulator for valves and cylinders that must not lose air suddenly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between SMC AKM and AK check valves?
faqs.a: SMC AKM is the modular check valve for building onto modular FRL units; the [SMC AK series check valve](/p/smc-ak-series-check-valve) is the stand-alone in-line valve for a pipe run, offered up to 1 inch. Both block reverse air flow.

faqs.q: Where are SMC AKM check valves shipped from and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: We ship SMC AKM modular check valves from our Dubai warehouse to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Check valves normally fall under HS 8481.30; country of origin depends on the SMC plant and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you keep SMC AKM modular check valves in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the SMC AKM series in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the AKM part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is the SMC Check Series Valve listing?
faqs.a: The SMC Check Series Valve listing groups three SMC check valves known by special part numbers: INA-14-386-N, INA-14-169-N20 and XTO-674-02AH. They are one-way valves for air lines, supplied to the exact SMC code rather than a catalogue series.

faqs.q: What do SMC part numbers INA-14-386-N and XTO-674-02AH mean?
faqs.a: INA-14-386-N and XTO-674-02AH are SMC special-product numbers, not catalogue model codes, so they cannot be decoded into size and thread. Order them by the full number on the old valve or drawing and we match it to the maker record.

faqs.q: Which SMC check valves are in the Check Series Valve listing?
faqs.a: Three SMC check valves are listed: INA-14-386-N, INA-14-169-N20 and XTO-674-02AH. If your number differs by even one character, send it as written; SMC special codes often differ in thread or seal.

faqs.q: How do I identify an SMC check valve with an INA-14 part number?
faqs.a: Read the full SMC code from the body or label, such as INA-14-169-N20, and send it with a photo and the port thread. We check it against the maker record; if the code is gone, the port thread and body length let us propose a catalogue [SMC AK series check valve](/p/smc-ak-series-check-valve) equivalent.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do SMC INA-14 and XTO-674 check valves have?
faqs.a: Pressure ratings for INA-14-386-N, INA-14-169-N20 and XTO-674-02AH are not published on this listing. Send the part number with your operating pressure and we confirm the figure from SMC before supply.

faqs.q: What documents come with SMC special check valves such as XTO-674-02AH?
faqs.a: This listing holds no datasheets or certificates for XTO-674-02AH or the INA-14 valves. If your project needs a certificate of conformity or drawing, say so in the enquiry and we request it from the maker with the order.

faqs.q: Which fittings connect to SMC check valves INA-14-386-N and INA-14-169-N20?
faqs.a: Use fittings of the same thread as the valve ports, confirmed from the SMC record for INA-14-386-N or INA-14-169-N20. Push-in connectors and adaptors are on our [pneumatic fittings and silencers shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How do you fit a replacement SMC check valve such as INA-14-169-N20?
faqs.a: Fit the replacement SMC check valve in the same orientation as the old one, with the flow arrow pointing the way air should pass. Depressurise the line, seal the threads, and leak-test before restarting the machine.

faqs.q: Where are SMC special check valves like XTO-674-02AH used?
faqs.a: SMC special check valves such as XTO-674-02AH are built into OEM machines where the builder specified a custom SMC part. Replacing like for like keeps the machine as designed; the wider [flow controls, check and quick exhaust valves shelf](/c/pneumatic-flow-check-valves) covers general check, flow and quick exhaust valves.

faqs.q: Can a standard SMC AK check valve replace an SMC INA-14-386-N?
faqs.a: Sometimes, if thread, size and flow match, but INA-14-386-N is a special part, so we check the SMC record before offering a standard valve. The [SMC AK series](/p/smc-ak-series-check-valve) is the usual catalogue choice for in-line duty.

faqs.q: Which HS code applies to SMC check valves INA-14-386-N and XTO-674-02AH?
faqs.a: Check valves such as INA-14-386-N and XTO-674-02AH normally fall under HS 8481.30 for check (non-return) valves. We ship from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; country of origin is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you stock SMC check valves INA-14-386-N, INA-14-169-N20 and XTO-674-02AH in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep these SMC check valves in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is an SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow control used for?
faqs.a: An SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow control screws into the exhaust port of a directional valve and throttles the exhaust air, setting cylinder speed at the valve instead of at the cylinder. This listing has 10 part numbers with a thumb-screw adjuster and nickel-plated brass body.

faqs.q: How do you read the SMC ASN2-N02-S part number?
faqs.a: ASN2-N02-S is the ASN2 exhaust port flow control with a 1/4 NPT thread (N = NPT, 02 = 1/4) and S for thread sealant. Without the N the thread is R (BSPT), as in ASN2-02; M5 and U10/32 mark the M5 x 0.8 and 10-32 UNF versions.

faqs.q: Which port sizes do SMC ASN2 exhaust flow controls come in?
faqs.a: SMC ASN2 exhaust flow controls are listed in M5 x 0.8, 10-32 UNF, and 1/8, 1/4, 3/8 and 1/2 in both R and NPT. For example ASN2-01 (1/8 R), ASN2-N03-S (3/8 NPT) and ASN2-U10/32 (10-32 UNF).

faqs.q: Should I choose an R or NPT SMC ASN2 exhaust flow control?
faqs.a: Choose by the valve exhaust port: R versions (ASN2-01 to ASN2-04) suit BSPT ports to ISO 7-1, and NPT versions (ASN2-N01-S to ASN2-N04-S) suit NPT ports to ASME B1.20.1. The two tapers look alike but do not seal in each other.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature can SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow controls take?
faqs.a: Our size table lists SMC ASN2 exhaust flow controls for 0 to 145 psi (about 10 bar), and the listing gives +23°F to +140°F (-5 to +60°C). They are for compressed air on valve exhausts.

faqs.q: What material is the SMC ASN2 exhaust flow control made of?
faqs.a: The SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow control has a nickel-plated brass body, which resists corrosion on shop-floor air. Adjustment is by thumb screw, so it can be set by hand without tools.

faqs.q: Which thread standards do SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow controls use?
faqs.a: SMC ASN2 threads are R (BSPT) to ISO 7-1, NPT to ASME B1.20.1, M5 x 0.8 or 10-32 UNF, set by the part number. No certificates are held on this listing; ask for a certificate of conformity with the order if your project needs one.

faqs.q: Which valves take an SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow control?
faqs.a: Any directional valve with a threaded exhaust port of the same size takes an SMC ASN2, typically a 5/2 or 5/3 solenoid valve feeding a double-acting cylinder. Valves are on our [solenoid valves and manifolds shelf](/c/pneumatic-solenoid-valves).

faqs.q: How do you adjust an SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow control?
faqs.a: Screw the SMC ASN2 into the valve exhaust port, close the thumb screw, then open it gradually until the cylinder runs at the speed you need. Fit one in each exhaust port to set extend and retract speeds separately. Our [cylinder speed control guide](/blog/cylinder-speed-control-and-quick-exhaust-valves) shows the circuit.

faqs.q: What is the difference between an SMC ASN2 and a cylinder-port speed controller?
faqs.a: An SMC ASN2 meters exhaust air at the valve, while a cylinder-port speed controller meters it at the cylinder, which gives tighter control on long tube runs. For cylinder-port types see [SMC air cylinder speed controls](/p/smc-air-cylinder-speed-controls).

faqs.q: Where are SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow controls shipped from and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: We ship SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow controls from Dubai to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. Pneumatic flow valves normally fall under HS 8481.20; country of origin follows the SMC plant and is stated on our commercial invoice.

faqs.q: Do you keep SMC ASN2 exhaust port flow controls in stock in Dubai?

faqs.q: What does the SMC Flow Control listing include?

faqs.q: How do you read the SMC AS2301F-01-06SA flow control part number?
faqs.a: AS2301F-01-06SA is an AS-F series universal-type speed controller with a 1/8 R (BSPT) thread (01) and a push-in fitting for 6 mm tube (06), with S marking thread sealant. Quote the final A exactly as listed.

faqs.q: What are SMC AS2201F-U01-08A and AS2201F-U02-08A flow controls?

faqs.q: What is the SMC ASP430F-N02-11S-X369 flow control?
faqs.a: ASP430F-N02-11S-X369 is an SMC ASP speed controller with pilot check valve, 1/4 NPT thread (N02) and 3/8" tube (11), with X369 marking a special version. Standard ASP sizes are on the [SMC pneumatic flow control and needle valves listing](/p/smc-pneumatic-flow-control-and-needle-valves).

faqs.q: What pressure range do SMC AS2201F and AS2301F flow controls work at?

faqs.q: Which thread standards apply to SMC flow controls such as AS2301F-01-06SA?

faqs.q: Which tubing fits SMC flow controls AS2301F-01-06SA and ASP430F-N02-11S-X369?

faqs.q: How do you adjust an SMC AS2201F flow control?

faqs.q: What is the SMC INA-14-312-03 flow control?

faqs.q: What is the difference between the SMC AS2301F universal and AS2201F elbow flow controls?
faqs.a: Both are SMC AS-F speed controllers with push-in fittings; AS2201F is the elbow type, while AS2301F is the universal type that SMC offers for different port orientations. The full range is on [SMC air cylinder speed controls](/p/smc-air-cylinder-speed-controls).

faqs.q: Which HS code applies to SMC flow controls such as AS2301F-01-06SA?
